prompt:
Scene:
A medium shot of a cathedral choir loft at night, viewed from the nave floor looking up at a 30-degree angle. The wooden choir stalls below are empty but the space above them is full of light.

Subject:
A hovering choir of simplified human-shaped holograms stands in two rising tiers above the wooden stalls, each figure made of thin cyan volumetric lines outlining a robed silhouette. Their mouths are faint amber circles of light, implying song. Between them float small staff-line ribbons of light that wrap around the group like a soft cage.

Important details:
The wooden stalls below are warm brown and carry real physical detail: carved end-caps, polished seat wood, candle drippings. Above them, the holograms are clearly non-physical — cyan wireframe with soft scattering. Amber mouth glows must cast real light onto the top of the stall edges, proving the holograms are emissive. No figure has a real face or detailed features.

Use case:
Hologram Cathedral Nave single study 3/5, focusing on a hologram choir above empty stalls.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio, no real human faces, no printed hymnals, no anachronistic modern microphones, no brand stage gear, no projected name tags.
title: Hovering Choir Hologram
description: Wireframe-cyan hologram figures float in two tiers above wooden choir stalls, their amber mouth glows casting real light on the wood.
